sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Kumar Ashutosh Srivastava

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.

By means of this application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., applicant-Kamarunnisha, who is involved in Case Crime No. 322 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 304B, 323, 504, 506 of I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act,
Police Station-Rudrapur Kotwali, District-Deoria, seeks enlargement on bail during the pendency of trial.
Perusal of order-sheet shows that the matter is pending since May 2022.
Earlier on 23.05.2022, the matter was taken up but none appeared on behalf of the applicant to press this bail application.

Today also, when case called out in revised list, none appears on behalf of the applicant to press this Kamarunnisha vs State Of U.P. on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/170269378/
1 bail application, whereas learned A.G.A. for the State is present but he is not aware about present status of trial of the applicant.
In view of the above, the instant bail application is dismissed for want of prosecution.
Order Date :- 18.5.2023
